lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hayden Stepanov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Hayden is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Hayden Stepanov is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Hayden kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Hayden's gone." Karl looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Hayden." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Arlo blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Hayden Stepanov, 41 days. The mantle passes to Arlo Gomez.

d41: At the grave, Karl, Judith, Saeko and 6 more speak for Arlo — "Hayden trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Arlo before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
